author: ivanlitteri
content:
Added the following proposal to support native PQ signatures with leanSPHINCS on top of frame transactions, in a way that is forward-compatible with 8288, to start discussing this there.

The need for an 8288 forward-compatible solution to this was mentioned in today's breakout. A couple of things that were mentioned as nice-to-haves in the final solution:
- Whatever we do, it needs to be forward compatible with 8288 (this includes leanPCS and leanMempool)
- The signature needs to be in the transaction

This initial proposal doesn't solve the second point, but happy to discuss why it'd be desirable in the PR.

I'll be working on completing the spec in the meantime.
